settings_editor_args_trailing_backslash: A backslash at the end has nothing to escape.
settings_editor_code_tab_code_font_hint: Font for the editor and diffs.
settings_editor_code_tab_code_font_size_: Text size in the editor and diffs.
settings_editor_code_tab_completion_diag: Completion, diagnostics, hover and go to definition from the language's server (downloaded on first use).
settings_editor_code_tab_format_the_file: Format the file with its language server every time it is saved.
settings_editor_code_tab_install_update_: Install, update or replace the server of each language.
settings_editor_code_tab_show_inferred_t: Show inferred types and parameter names inline, dimmed.
settings_editor_code_tab_space_between_l: Space between lines, as a multiple of the font size. 1.5 is comfortable.
settings_editor_code_tab_which_servers_a: Which servers are installed, custom commands and options are in the Languages tab.
settings_editor_command_problem: Put only the program here. Arguments go in the field below.
settings_editor_custom_apply_note: Changes apply to servers started after you save; restart the server to apply now.
settings_editor_custom_args_help: Separated by spaces. Use quotes for a value with spaces: --root "My Projects".
settings_editor_custom_command_help: A program on your PATH or an absolute path. Leave empty to use the server Atlas finds or installs.
settings_editor_custom_init_help: Sent once when the server starts (a JSON object).
settings_editor_custom_last_valid_kept: {error} The last valid value is still in use.
settings_editor_custom_settings_help: Sent to the server as workspace configuration (a JSON object).
settings_editor_json_not_object: Must be a JSON object, like {example}.
settings_editor_languages_tab_atlas_find: Atlas finds a server on your PATH or downloads one the first time you open a file of that language.
settings_editor_languages_tab_could_not_: Could not load the language servers: {loadError}
settings_editor_languages_tab_language_f: Language features need a newer terminal host
settings_editor_languages_tab_note: Custom servers and options are saved under lsp in your {#user}settings.json{/user}. A project can override them with the same lsp shape in {#project}.atlas/settings.json{/project}; the project's options win.
settings_editor_languages_tab_open_workt: Open a worktree first, then Atlas can show its .atlas/settings.json.
settings_editor_languages_tab_the_runnin: The running terminal host is from an older Atlas and cannot run language servers. Use the language server item in the editor's status bar to update it; terminals keep running until you choose to restart.
settings_editor_languages_tab_uninstall_: Atlas deletes the copy it downloaded. You can install it again at any time.
settings_editor_open_worktree_first: Open a worktree first, then Atlas can show settings.json in its editor.
settings_editor_rows_add_a_final_newline: Add a final newline on save
settings_editor_rows_animate_scrolling_w: Animate scrolling when you jump to a line or use the keyboard.
settings_editor_rows_columns_a_tab_or_on: Columns a tab or one level of indentation spans.
settings_editor_rows_columns_where_a_ver: Columns where a vertical line is drawn, such as 80 or 100. Separate several with commas.
settings_editor_rows_draw_a_faint_vertic: Draw a faint vertical line at each level of indentation.
settings_editor_rows_draw_dots_for_space: Draw dots for spaces and arrows for tabs.
settings_editor_rows_end_every_file_with: End every file with exactly one newline when you save.
settings_editor_rows_files_bigger_than_t: Files bigger than this open in a light mode without language features, so the editor stays fast. 0.1 to 100 MB.
settings_editor_rows_give_each_level_of_: Give each level of nested brackets its own color.
settings_editor_rows_keep_the_enclosing_: Keep the enclosing function or class pinned at the top while you scroll its body.
settings_editor_rows_let_the_last_line_s: Let the last line scroll up to the top of the editor.
settings_editor_rows_pressing_tab_insert: Pressing Tab inserts spaces. Turn off to insert tab characters.
settings_editor_rows_remove_spaces_and_t: Remove spaces and tabs at the end of lines when you save.
settings_editor_rows_show_a_small_overvi: Show a small overview of the file on the right.
settings_editor_rows_show_line_numbers_i: Show line numbers in the gutter.
settings_editor_rows_tint_the_line_the_c: Tint the line the cursor is on.
settings_editor_rows_update_an_open_file: Update an open file when another program changes it, as long as you have no unsaved edits in it.
settings_editor_rows_wrap_long_lines_at_: Wrap long lines at the edge of the editor.
